title: Woman Seated in Living Room, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot depicting a woman seated in a patterned armchair in a cozy home living room setting. In the background, a bookshelf holds books, decorative glass vases, and framed family portraits. To the left, a decorated Christmas tree catches the light, evoking a holiday family moment typical of mid-century suburban American life. The top margin displays a photofinishing stamp that reads 'FEB'.
